description: This file defines the class RetrieveFeatureResponse, which is a response object for a RetrieveFeature command within a system that manages 'things' and their features. It includes methods for creating instances, serialization/deserialization, and accessing the retrieved feature data.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureResponse
classes.description: A final immutable class representing the response to a RetrieveFeature command, encapsulating the Thing ID, the retrieved Feature, and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveFeatureResponse given ThingId, featureId, a JSON object, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a RetrieveFeatureResponse from a JSON string or object, along with headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the retrieved feature.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the feature.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity JSON for the response, returning a new instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the response, returning a new instance.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer resource path for this response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends response data to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if this object can be equal to another, used in equality checks.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on thingId and feature.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on object fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
